what: Key copy (reused: it runs through the copy heads) against the prior-matched cipher (new: it does not), both on E147's 96 keys, M's log10 prior on the answer -4.23 and -4.43: fine-tuned again with E147's exact call at seeds 0-9, scaled to E237's common size, read with eight cheap readings. Does each reading split the pair at 10 seeds, by a seed-level rank test, while the prior (0.20 decades apart by construction) does not?

settings.tasks_source: E237's matched-prior pair (experiments/key_grid/results/summary.json log10_prior: copy -4.228, prior_cipher -4.429); E147's windows files (experiments/refit_96key/results/inventory.json maps.<task>.windows)
settings.seeds_source: the cell: 10 seeds each. Seeds 0-2 are E147's and must repeat its saved files bit for bit (E147 reproduced E58's kept files with max |diff| 0, experiments/refit_96key/results/stage0.json states.*.kept)
settings.random_seeds_source: one matched random update beside each of seeds 0-2 of each task, as E237 read (its random_<state> items); 6 items, not 20, to keep the job near 30 min
settings.random_seed_source: a new seed (E237's was 237001, E250's 249101, the cued copy's 254201); state i of this run's order takes random_seed + i

thresholds.share_new_max_source: P2.54 run 1's labels (experiments/prior_mech_2x2/results/predictions.json): the reused side's mean (2,4) share at or over 0.2 with every seed over its clean null median; the new side's at or under 0.2
thresholds.alpha_source: filed here: exact two-sided Mann-Whitney p at or under 0.01 (10 vs 10 seeds with no overlap gives 1.1e-5, so the bar is met with room; one reading of 8 passing by chance at 0.01 has probability under 0.08)
thresholds.expected_sign_source: E237's 3-seed gaps (copy minus prior_cipher; experiments/key_grid and prior_mech_2x2 results): head +0.248, r +0.403, erank +68.4, steering pooled +0.566, steering per-key -0.086, neuron k64 +0.0145, k matched +0.0070. k = 3 is khead's filed expectation (copy 0.5-0.8, ciphers under 0.05, predictions_khead.json)
thresholds.p_learn_source: E12's P_LEARN (keydep.scored_step): held-out P(target) at step 30. E147 read 0.986-0.998 for copy and 0.936-0.961 for prior_cipher (refit_96key stage0.json)

measurement.update: each saved fine-tune times c_task = E237's common size (experiments/key_grid/results/stage0.json target, 0.0073022) over the task's mean E187 size over its 10 seeds; a random update: a Gaussian at the state's per-matrix norms (finetune.random_direction) times the same c
measurement.readings: per item, on the task's E147 read rows: head_share = khead's k = 1 share of the gain lost with (2,4) mean-ablated, k3_share = with M's top 3 prefix heads off ((1,1) excluded), both counted only when the label is readable (gain >= G_min 5.15); r = E228's re-gating share (log-odds form); erank = the ||dW||^2-weighted effective rank (update_spectrum.state); steering_pooled, steering_perkey, neuron_k64, neuron_kmatched = holes_fill's shares (gain floor 1)
measurement.gap: per reading, mean over copy's 10 seeds minus mean over prior_cipher's 10
measurement.band: per reading, the smallest gap that matters: the larger seed range of the two tasks at seeds 0-2 in this job (E237's spread measure; E237 read head 0.081, r 0.0039, erank 5.94, steering pooled 0.0186, per-key 0.0544, neuron k64 0.0037, k matched 0.0067)
measurement.rank_test: exact two-sided Mann-Whitney U over seeds (commute.seed_rank.mann_whitney: every relabelling of the 20 values, mid-ranks for ties)
measurement.prior: M's log10 geometric-mean P(answer) on the read rows, E133's path, saved (key_grid summary.json log10_prior); one number per task, the same at every seed

rules.A0_controls: stage 0 passes: run 1's control (M's second-copy top-1 0.825 falls under 0.3 with (2,4) off, median over 0.7 with random single heads off; a zero update reads F = M exactly), khead's M control (top k off; k = 1 within 0.01 of E62's 0.0095), the copy prior repeats 5.9107e-5 within 1e-4 relative, holes_fill's shares on e58/copy_s0 at c = 1 repeat E147's within 0.01
rules.A0_do_nothing: the zero update on copy's rows: khead's G and every G_off, holes_fill's gain, r's gain and the size read 0 exactly; the seven gain readings read nan
rules.A1_recipe_repeats: seeds 0-2 of each task against E147's saved bf16 files: max |diff| = 0 (reported, not a stop: all 20 states come from this run's own fine-tunes either way)
rules.A2_labels: reused_uses_head and new_does_not hold (P2.54 run 1's rule on khead's k = 1 arm, world.labels); if either misses, every call reads not_read
rules.A3_calls: per reading: 'separates' when p <= alpha and |gap| > band; 'does_not_separate' otherwise; 'not_read' when a seed reads nan or the labels miss. The sign is reported against expected_sign
rules.A4_prior: the prior's gap, copy minus prior_cipher, 0.200 decades; constant over seeds, so its rank test reads p = 1 (does_not_separate) by construction
rules.A5_random: random_reads_nothing holds: every random update reads nan on the seven gain readings (each under its reader's gain gate)

expected.W0: no update: every reading over the gain is undefined (gain 0), so every A3 call reads not_read; the labels read not_read
expected.do_nothing: A0_do_nothing exactly as filed; the do-nothing cannot pass any A3 bar (its readings are nan)
expected.control: A0_controls pass (run 1, E249, and E250 passed every one of them on this card type); A1 max |diff| 0; A2 holds (E249: copy 0.248 with each seed over its null median, prior_cipher 0.0001); A5 holds (E250's random updates read nan, gain 0.00-0.03)
expected.rival_a_mechanism: each reading follows the mechanism: at 10 seeds it splits copy from the prior-matched cipher as at 3 seeds. Expected calls: head, k3, r, erank, steering pooled, neuron k64 separate with E237's sign, the gaps near E237's (0.25, 0.5-0.8 for k3, 0.40, 68, 0.57, 0.015); steering per-key separates with the sign reversed (-0.09, the cipher higher); neuron k matched sits at its band (gap 0.0070 against 0.0067 at 3 seeds), so either call fits this rival
expected.rival_b_prior: each reading follows the prior, which is 0.20 decades apart: E237's 3-seed gaps were seed luck, and at 10 seeds the rank test reads p > 0.01 or the gap shrinks inside the band, so the calls read does_not_separate

stop_rules.stage0: any A0 control or the do-nothing missing: exit 1 before any fine-tune
stop_rules.learn: a seed with held-out P(target) under p_learn at step 30: exit 1 (E147's recipe failed to train on this card)

edge_cases.nan_seed: a seed reading nan (a gain under its reader's gate) makes that reading not_read: no call is drawn from fewer seeds
edge_cases.ties: tied values take mid-ranks; the exact null is over every relabelling, so p stays exact
edge_cases.constant: a reading constant over all 20 seeds (the prior): p = 1, does_not_separate
edge_cases.band_zero: band 0 (identical seeds 0-2): any nonzero gap passes the band; the rank test still has to pass
edge_cases.band_nan: a nan at seeds 0-2 gives a nan band: not_read
edge_cases.labels_miss: A2 missing turns every call into not_read: the pair is not a reused / new pair at 10 seeds, which is itself the result
edge_cases.sign: a reading that separates with the sign opposite to expected_sign is reported as separating, with sign_as_filed false

blind_to.head_share: what the update does outside the copy head; a copy routed through other heads reads low
blind_to.k3_share: the same, for heads outside M's top 3
blind_to.r: the split of the update's own effect only; blind to whether a re-gated path computes the same function as M's
blind_to.erank: what the directions do; reads the spread of the update's spectrum only
blind_to.steering: nonlinear effects; reads what one added vector per layer (pooled or per key) recovers
blind_to.neuron: anything outside the top-k MLP neurons
blind_to.prior: everything after the answer prior; matched here by construction, so it reads 0.2 decades whatever the mechanism

positive_control: E237's 3-seed readings of this very pair (the expected values); within this job, seeds 0-2 repeat E147's states bit for bit, so their readings repeat E237's up to the change in c
noise_floor: the band: the 3-seed seed range at seeds 0-2, this job (E237's measure)
time_estimate: from the measured logs: E252's khead job (prior_mech_2x2/results/run3.log: load 13 s, khead's M control 4 s, 6-17 s per item) and E253's cued copy (cued_copy/results/run.log: one item's khead, holes_fill and r reads 46 s, 19:23:52 -> 19:24:38; whole job 7 min); E250's run2.log: a 300-step fine-tune 11 s, split bases 13 s. Run A: load and controls ~40 s; 20 fine-tunes x 11 s = 220 s; 27 items (20 states, 6 random, 1 do-nothing) x 46 s = 1242 s. Sum ~1500 s, about 25 min. Debug QoS (2 h cap), $0
